Michael Luther King Jr. was born in Atlanta, Georgia on January 15, 1929, to Mrs. Alberta King and Baptist minister Michael L. King Sr.
King spent his early years at 501 Auburn Avenue, about a block from Ebrnezer Baptist Church where his father was pastor.

In September 1951, King enrolled in Boston University’s PhD program in systematic theology. King met Coretta Scott while at Boston University and they were married on June 18, 1953, in Perry County, Alabama.
King enrolled at Morehouse College, where he majored in sociology. Drawn to the ministry, King Jr. was ordained by his father as the Baptist minister in February 1948.
